Belle Sorciere:

It's kind of premature to say 2/3 of it will be useless to you.

Given the modesty of what I'd like, and the general size and structure of RPG sourcebooks (from TSR, White Wolf, Wizards of the Coast, R Talsorian, FASA, right up to FFG), 2/3rds is conservative. A lore book has to contain system information to cover a lot of possible usages, include story information of various points in history, and generally give over a fair amount of space to illustrations and reference tables.
